subject: CedarBridge: slotting conflict & scaling ask
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@cedarbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cedarbridge.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: July-Q3 capacity need (CedarBridge)

Ben —

Quick note from my side: our product team has moved up the Q3 feature launch and we need to secure additional dedicated capacity for July-September. Current ask below: 

- 4x A100-class GPUs (or equivalent throughput profile) dedicated for 24/7 inference
- Expected traffic: 18–22M inference requests / month (MAU spike)
- Preferred start: 2028-07-08

We understand this is a short lead time but this is critical to our go-live. Attaching our forecast and a one-page RTO justification. Can you confirm feasibility and whether Redwood can hold a short-term burst while we finalize a committed reserved term?

Thanks — happy to jump on a call.

Ellen Park
Head of Platform
CedarBridge

[Attachment: CedarBridge_MAU_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@cedarbridge.com>, procurement@cedarbridge.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: July-Q3 capacity need (CedarBridge)

Looping ops and deals — Ellen just flagged an urgent short lead-time request for 4x A100-class dedicated slots starting 7/8 for three months. Key constraints: we have limited free buffer in the US reserved pool and multiple overlapping demos next month. Options I see: 

1) Short-term burst (30–60 days) billed at premium overage + temporary isolation.
2) Move 2x from Pilot tranche (internal buffer) and supplement with burst credits for the remaining 2x.
3) Accelerate a long-term reserved commitment (6+ months) in exchange for a commercial concession.

Attaching a quick commercial sketch and usage summary. Laura: can you run capacity check and call out what service-impact (if any) moving two pilot GPUs would have? Rishi/Monica: want to align on the minimum commercial ask so I can reply to Ellen with a crisp MAM and next steps.

Thanks — I can host a 20m sync if helpful.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: CedarBridge_capacity_sketch.pdf (one-page)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@cedarbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: July-Q3 capacity need (CedarBridge)

Ben — quick capacity note (summary of checks performed):

- US reserved pool utilization: 82% across all deals (last 72h average).
- Pilot tranche (internal buffer): 2x A100-equivalent nodes available; reassigning would reduce our pilot headroom by ~45% for July demo schedule.
- Spare preemptible capacity in us-west: up to 3x on a best-effort basis, but not suitable for SLA-backed dedicated isolation.

Recommendation: offer a two-part path to CedarBridge — (A) immediate 2x reassign from pilot + 2x short-term burst (30 days) with higher overage rate and service notice; (B) commit to a 6‑month reserved contract to be effective 2028-08-01 with preferential pricing and a guaranteed slot migration plan.

Risk notes: shifting the pilot pool increases demo failure risk for internal trials and could require one-time re-scheduling with product partners. If CedarBridge requires strict SLA isolation from day one, we need to prioritize them over lower-ARR pilots.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call with CedarBridge today or tomorrow to (1) align expected start date, (2) confirm isolation/SLA requirements, and (3) surface commercial tradeoffs.

Laura Bennett
Head of Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

[Inline: detailed capacity checks attached to internal ticket: INC-7643]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: July-Q3 capacity need (CedarBridge)

Thanks for the quick analysis. Commercial context from my side:

- CedarBridge is in procurement review for a potential SANDBOX+Reserved deal; ARR expectation is ~USD 480k/yr if they take 6 months+ commitment.
- If we can secure a 6-month reserved start date of 2028-08-01, I can push for a 10% uplift on list price in exchange for the immediate 30-day burst at a reduced overage.
- If we only offer best-effort preemptible capacity for the extra headroom, CedarBridge will likely walk to a competitor for SLA-backed launch.

Commercial ask: approve two temporary reassignments from pilot + 2x burst for July with the following guardrails: 
- Documented MAM with milestone: commit to reserved SKU by 2028-07-20 or capacity will be reclaimed.
- Standard SLA exception clause for short-term burst (no premium SLA).

If ops signs off on the pilot impact, I recommend we present option (A) as a time-bound bridge and (B) as the primary lane.

Rishi
Director, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@cedarbridge.com>, procurement@cedarbridge.com
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: CedarBridge: slotting conflict & scaling ask — proposed two-step plan

Ellen — thanks again for the fast context and for sharing the forecast. Below is a practical two-step proposal so your launch can proceed without delay while aligning commercial terms quickly: 

1) Immediate (start target 2028-07-08): 
   - 2x A100-class dedicated slots reassigned from internal Pilot tranche (temporary)
   - 2x A100-class short-term burst capacity (30 days) with overage pricing at 1.6x list
   - SLA: burst capacity is best-effort; the two reassigned pilot slots get standard dedicated isolation for the 30-day window

2) Committed follow-on (start target 2028-08-01 if CedarBridge signs): 
   - 6-month reserved commitment for 4x slots (preferred pricing; 10% discount available with written commitment by 2028-07-20)
   - Migration plan and guaranteed isolation to be documented in MAM/contract addendum

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm acceptance of the temporary two-step approach by EOD Monday 2028-07-02.
- If accepted, I'll share a one-page MAM and schedule a 30-minute alignment call (suggest: Mon 7/1 10:00am PT).

Attachments: proposed one-page MAM and a short SLA impact summary.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-scaling-agreement.docx (document)]
[Attachment: SLA-impact-summary.pdf (pdf)]
